summary.intent: Get PR #268 unblocked by resolving its merge conflict and fixing its CI coverage failure, then review the agent review findings on trail 127 (change caliper/65).
summary.outcome: Merged origin/main into #268 (signed merge commit e8d9285b, fast-forward push), resolved the docs conflict, and fixed the Coverage job by adding the CALIPER_TEST_TSC variable. Local checks pass; CI re-run status and human Entire Gates approval are still pending. Four medium findings on #267 were read and judged real, but nothing has been fixed yet.

repo: The new CI rule makes real-checker tests fail when CI is set and CALIPER_TEST_TSC isn't. Any CI job that runs those tests (e.g. Coverage, Test / Rust) needs that variable.
Entire Gates is a human approval step that the agent does not give.
PR #268 showed BLOCKED because required checks were pending, review was outstanding and the merge queue applied, not because of conflicts.
Agent review findings are attached to a trail and change (trail 127, change caliper/65). That change belonged to #267, not #268, so check which PR a change maps to before acting.
docs/type-checker-integration.md conflicted because main already carried the v4 'Not carried' line from #266.

code.finding: memo(forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>()) with no render argument and one type argument indexes params[1] and panics. The containment fallback then drops every component in that file.

Alias shapes such as type ButtonProps = Omit<ComponentProps<"button">, "color"> are stored as an Omit alias and the tag check ignores them. Tagged factories previously detected via the {Name}Props name now disappear, a regression against main. Partial, Required, Pick and union aliases are also affected.

A private factory is promoted before Group = withContext<…, GroupProps>(StyledGroup), so it takes GroupProps and emits an extra component. The StyledGroup fix only covers components detected immediately, not pending ones.
A foreign forwardRef with type arguments falls through to generic-wrapper promotion and loses the ref it had before.

workflow: Merge origin/main into a PR branch with a signed merge commit and a fast-forward push, rather than force-pushing.
Run lint, docs, typos and the full test suite locally, plus the CI-only tests with CI=1 and the required env var, before claiming a CI fix.
Report unverified items plainly, such as CI re-run status and findings not checked against running code.
Ask for confirmation before pushing fixes to a different PR branch (#267 on feat/detect-by-shape).

friction: The Coverage CI failure was caused by the agent's own earlier change, which added the CI rule without updating the Coverage job's environment.
The merge conflict in the docs file came from overlapping work on #266 and #268.
Review findings for #267 surfaced while working on #268, which risked confusion over which PR they applied to.
open_items: Fix the four medium findings on #267 (panic on memo(forwardRef<T>()), alias shapes rejected, promotion order, foreign forwardRef with type args) with exact-content tests and push to feat/detect-by-shape, pending user approval.
Confirm the CI re-run on #268 passes after the Coverage env var fix.
Entire Gates human approval on #268 is still needed.
The four #267 findings have not been verified against running code.
